name: Velnora Addons For Elementor
author: Abdul Samad

sections.description:
Velnora Addons For Elementor adds 191 widgets, configurable forms, popups, loop templates and a theme template engine to the free version of Elementor. Elementor Pro is not required. WooCommerce is optional: 38 of the 191 widgets need it. Every feature is available to every administrator; nothing is locked, limited by time or unlocked by a license.

Order on WhatsApp

  • Style automatic buttons in Velnora Addons > WhatsApp Orders > Automatic button design. Product cards and single-product pages have separate controls. Tablet values apply up to 1024px, mobile up to 767px; blank device values inherit.
  • Configure Velnora Addons > WhatsApp Orders: international phone number, button label and message template. Automatic buttons are off until you enable them.
  • Enable automatic buttons on standard WooCommerce shop/category cards, supported WooCommerce product-button blocks and Velnora product grids. Optional single-product placement is separate. Existing Add to cart buttons remain available.
  • Use the Order on WhatsApp Elementor widget inside a product Loop item or single-product template. Current product is automatic, or choose a fixed product ID. Custom cards that do not run standard WooCommerce hooks can use this widget.
  • Messages support {product_name}, {price}, {sku}, {product_url}, {product_id} and {quantity}. Product-page quantity is included when a matching WooCommerce form is present. Select a variation on the product page before ordering a variable product.
  • Clicking opens a prefilled WhatsApp chat. The visitor must press Send; this does not create a WooCommerce order, collect a payment, or send a message automatically.

Widgets

  • Carousel: native editable slide containers. Add, duplicate, reorder or remove slides, and drag any Elementor widgets or nested containers into each slide. Includes responsive slides per view/scroll, equal height, autoplay, hover/interaction pause, wraparound, direction, offsets, custom arrows and dots/fraction/progress pagination. Requires Elementor Free with Containers and Nested Elements enabled. No Elementor Pro code or license is required.

  • Autoplay and wraparound are inactive in the editor so slide contents remain editable. Use Preview to check animation. Wraparound uses Swiper rewind without cloning widgets or creating duplicate form IDs. Autoplay respects reduced-motion preferences, the plugin motion settings, keyboard focus and browser visibility.

  • 191 widgets in seven collections (content, interactive, media, WordPress, WooCommerce, forms and theme builder).

  • Six design presets: Minimal, Elevated, Outlined, Aurora gradient, Midnight and Frosted, plus a global accent color. Each widget has color, spacing, typography, border, shadow and hover controls where they apply.
  • Whatsapp Chat: a floating chat button that fixes itself to a screen corner. Side, distance, label, colors, typography, text alignment, shadow, pulse and per-device visibility are configurable.
  • Six FAQ layouts (classic, icon list, cards, two columns, numbered, minimal lines) with your own open/close icons, one-at-a-time mode, structured data and full style controls.
  • Flip Book (page-turning book with front and back pages) and Infinite Text Carousel (endless text ticker).
  • Flip Box with eight effects, testimonials, timelines, pricing, team and portfolio cards and many more.
  • A searchable dashboard to switch widgets on and off. Optional promotion of Velnora widgets to the top of Elementor’s widget panel. Every Velnora widget shows a small “VA” badge in the panel.

Forms

  • Velnora Form, Contact, Quote Request, Callback, Custom Form, Newsletter Signup, Booking Request, Job Application and Feedback forms.
  • Fields: text, email, telephone, URL, textarea, select, radio, checkbox groups, acceptance, number, date, time, country, hidden defaults and step separators (up to 30 fields).
  • Email section for each form: To (up to 5 addresses), Subject, Message with [all-fields] and {field_id} tokens, From, Reply-To, Cc, Bcc, HTML or plain text and an optional confirmation to the visitor. A Send test email button and the last delivery result are in Velnora Addons > Forms & inbox.
  • Spam protection: optional Google reCAPTCHA v2 or v3 (keys saved in Forms & inbox), a hidden honeypot field, signed and expiring form configuration, nonce refresh, browser and IP rate limits. This is basic abuse protection, not a guarantee.
  • Optional country flags: telephone fields show a flag and dial code, detect the country from the number and add the default country code; the Country field has a searchable flag list. Flags are small inline images; there are no external requests.
  • Notifications use wp_mail. Configure hosting mail or an SMTP plugin; a successful hand-off does not prove inbox delivery. File uploads, payments and mailing-service integrations are not included.
  • Optional private storage of submissions with a retention period of 7, 14, 30, 60 or 90 days (default 30). A daily WordPress cron task removes expired entries in batches of up to 200. Entries linked to an email address support WordPress privacy export and erase. Add a privacy notice before enabling storage.

Theme Builder, loops and popups

  • Header, Footer, Single post, Single page, Single product, Archive, Product archive/shop, Search results, 404, Loop item, Reusable section and Popup templates, edited with Elementor.
  • Include and exclude display rules (entire site, front page, blog, post types, specific content, archives, taxonomies, search and 404). A template priority can decide between overlapping templates. New templates and JSON imports start inactive.
  • “Pause all Velnora layouts” restores the original theme without deleting anything.
  • Loop item templates have a dedicated settings panel with Preview Settings and Query. Loop Grid and Loop Carousel can use the saved query.
  • Popup templates have Layout, Triggers (page load, scroll, scroll to element, click, inactivity, exit intent, AdBlock detection) and Advanced Rules (times shown, page views, hide after closing, devices, logged-in visitors). Open a popup from any link set to #velnora-popup-ID. Popup scripts and styles load only on pages that show a popup.
  • Template JSON import and export. Imports are limited in size and nesting and never run uploaded code.
  • A template can be inserted anywhere with the shortcode [velnora_template id=”123″].
  • Velnora-rendered template HTML allows normal layout markup, forms and safe SVG icons. Raw script/style blocks and iframe/object/embed content are excluded. Use enqueued assets for custom functionality. Elementor template CSS is enqueued separately; FAQ structured data is printed in the footer.
  • Matching requests use a Velnora site shell with wp_head, wp_body_open and wp_footer; the active theme’s own layout is not preserved there. Cart, checkout and account pages stay with WooCommerce and the active theme. Test on a staging copy first.

This plugin is an independent implementation. It does not bundle Elementor Pro, does not unlock Pro widgets and does not claim feature parity with Elementor Pro.

WooCommerce widgets

Product filter grid and bar, advanced product search, quick view grid, product list, sale carousel, category and brand showcase, recently viewed, wishlist, compare and stock notice. Wishlist, compare and recently viewed lists are stored only in the visitor’s browser (localStorage) and product IDs are sent only to your own website to read public catalog data.

Privacy

The plugin has no account, license check, telemetry or tracking. All scripts and styles are bundled. The only external connections are described in “External services” below and happen only when you switch the related feature on. Form protection stores temporary salted hashes for rate limits (no raw IP address) and the form refresh response sets a first-party, HttpOnly cookie named velnora_form_client for one day.

External services

This plugin can connect to the following third-party services. None of them is used unless the site owner turns the feature on.

Google reCAPTCHA (spam protection for forms)

Used when you save reCAPTCHA keys in Velnora Addons > Forms & inbox and leave the reCAPTCHA switch on in a form. When a visitor opens such a form, the visitor’s browser loads the script https://www.google.com/recaptcha/api.js from Google. When the form is sent, your website sends the reCAPTCHA response token, your secret key and the visitor’s IP address to https://www.google.com/recaptcha/api/siteverify to check the visitor. Google may also collect data about the visitor’s browser and behavior as described in its policies. Service provider: Google LLC. Terms of Service: https://policies.google.com/terms. Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy. About reCAPTCHA: https://www.google.com/recaptcha/about/. Mention this service in your own privacy policy.

WhatsApp (chat and product order buttons)

Chat and order buttons are normal links to https://wa.me/ followed by the phone number and optional message you configured. Nothing is sent when the page loads. When a visitor clicks the button, the visitor’s browser opens WhatsApp, which receives the number and message text. For product order buttons, the configured message can contain the selected public product name, displayed price, SKU, quantity and product URL. These details are included only when the visitor opens the WhatsApp link. No WhatsApp API key or paid service is required. Service provider: WhatsApp LLC (Meta). Terms of Service: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/terms-of-service. Privacy Policy: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/privacy-policy.

Social share links (optional Social Share Links widget)

The widget contains links only; no social script is loaded. When a visitor clicks a link, the chosen service receives the current page URL (and, for WhatsApp and email, the page title). Services: Facebook (Terms: https://www.facebook.com/terms.php, Privacy: https://www.facebook.com/privacy/policy), LinkedIn (Terms: https://www.linkedin.com/legal/user-agreement, Privacy: https://www.linkedin.com/legal/privacy-policy) and WhatsApp (see above).

Images, media and fonts that you choose in your designs may create their own external requests.

Source code

All JavaScript and CSS files in this plugin (the assets folder) are the original, human-readable, unminified source. No build tools, bundlers or minifiers are used, so there is nothing to compile. The PHP source is in the includes and templates folders.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate Elementor 3.20 or newer.
  2. Upload this ZIP through Plugins > Add New Plugin > Upload Plugin and activate it, or install it from the Plugins screen.
  3. Open Velnora Addons for the Dashboard, Widgets, Settings, Forms & inbox, Theme Builder, Tools and Template import/export. Use the Widgets switches and Save changes, then reload Elementor.
  4. Edit a page with Elementor and search for Velnora or a widget’s name.
  5. Install WooCommerce for the 38 store widgets.
  6. Forms: open Velnora Addons > Forms & inbox, set the default recipient and press Send test email. Add reCAPTCHA keys there if you want spam protection.
sections.faq:
Why do I see 153 widgets instead of 191?

Thirty-eight widgets require WooCommerce. Disabled widgets are hidden from the editor. If Velnora widgets are missing, open Velnora Addons and use Restore Velnora widgets, then reload the editor.

Is Elementor Pro required?

No. The plugin works with free Elementor 3.20 or newer.

How do I set up form email and reCAPTCHA?

Open Velnora Addons > Forms & inbox, set the default recipient and press Send test email. Add your reCAPTCHA site and secret keys (create them at google.com/recaptcha/admin; v2 and v3 keys are different) and save. In Elementor each Velnora form has an Email section and a Spam Protection section. Use [all-fields] in the message for every answer or {field_id}, for example {name}, for one answer.

How do I use the Theme Builder safely?

Open Velnora Addons > Theme Builder and choose a type. New templates start inactive: preview them, set Include/Exclude rules, tick Active when published, then publish. A matching Exclude always wins. If a layout looks wrong, use Pause all Velnora layouts. Save a template’s type and press Update before choosing Edit with Elementor so the Loop item or Popup panel opens.

How do popups and loops work?

Create a template of type Popup or Loop item. A popup shows while it is published, active and its display rules match; open it from any link set to #velnora-popup-ID. Select a published Loop item in Loop Grid, Loop Carousel or Archive Loop.

Are emails guaranteed?

No. Mail transport must be configured and tested on your hosting. Clear or shorten full-page caching for form pages so cached nonces do not expire.

What happens on uninstall?

Widget preferences, general settings and the cleanup schedule are removed. User-created templates, Elementor page data and stored enquiries are kept. Export or erase personal entries first if they should not remain.

Are WordPress.org approval, theme compatibility or top search ranking guaranteed?

No. Test on a staging copy of your website before going live.
sections.changelog:
1.11.1

  • Add separate automatic WhatsApp button styling for product cards and single-product pages.
  • Add desktop/tablet/mobile alignment, width, font/icon sizes, padding, corner radius and spacing.
  • Add solid/gradient backgrounds, text/icon/hover colors, borders and shadow controls.
  • Improve narrow product-card layouts and default left alignment without changing WhatsApp message behavior.

1.11.0

  • Add Order on WhatsApp widget with current-loop or fixed-product selection and button styling.
  • Add WhatsApp Orders settings with validated international number, automatic card/single-product placement and editable message tokens.
  • Support standard WooCommerce cards, product-button blocks and Velnora product grids without replacing Add to cart.
  • Keep product details scoped to the clicked button, escape output and restrict settings changes to administrators with a nonce.

1.10.0

  • Add Carousel, an original nested-container widget with three editable slides by default.
  • Add responsive slide counts and gaps, playback controls, custom arrow positions, slide styling, and dots/fraction/progress pagination.
  • Support native slide add, duplicate, reorder and remove actions in Elementor Free.
  • Load Elementor-provided Swiper and carousel assets only when required. Respect reduced-motion settings and avoid cloned slide content.

1.9.3

  • Escape generated text and HTML at final output across widgets, popups, loops, admin controls and the site shell.
  • Use a scoped HTML allowlist that retains form controls, accessible labels, interactive attributes and safe SVG geometry.
  • Enqueue Elementor template CSS separately and filter template output consistently for shortcodes, saved templates, popups and site layouts.
  • Output FAQ JSON-LD through the WordPress script API in the footer, outside filtered template content.
  • Require a nonce as well as the signed configuration for catalog AJAX requests; sanitize request data and JSON upload metadata.
  • Respect the active toggle for popup templates.

1.9.2

  • Constrain legacy metadata upgrades to Velnora templates and form entries.
  • Filter template shortcode HTML while retaining standard layout and form markup. Shortcode output excludes inline scripts, raw style blocks, and iframe embeds.
  • Remove template metadata writes when opening Elementor.
  • Strengthen template save nonce checks and sanitize form request values.

1.9.1

  • Every feature is available to every administrator; the earlier edition split was removed.
  • Template settings are stored with a longer prefix (existing data is migrated automatically).
  • Admin menu styling is enqueued with wp_add_inline_style; JavaScript files are shipped as readable source.
  • Readme documents the external services (Google reCAPTCHA, WhatsApp and social share links).
  • Control labels in the WooCommerce widgets are translatable.

1.9.0

  • Optional country flags in forms, new Country field, five FAQ layouts and FAQ options, Flip Book and Infinite Text Carousel widgets.

1.8.0

  • Whatsapp Chat widget, “VA” badge, Loop item settings panel and Popup template type.

1.7.0

  • Email section per form, Google reCAPTCHA, delivery test and four new ready-made forms.

1.6.0

  • First public release.
